newsitem.title: USA: Marijuana may lead to other drug addictions-study.
newsitem.headline: Marijuana may lead to other drug addictions-study.

text.p: Long-term marijuana use produces changes in the brain that may make users more vulnerable to addiction to other drugs such as cocaine, heroin and alcohol, according to a study released on Thursday.
The study by the National Institute on Drug Abuse also provided more evidence that marijuana can be addictive, the U.S. government's National Institutes of Health said in a statement.

"The finding from this and other studies...suggests that addiction to one drug may make a person more vulnerable to abuse and addiction of other drugs," the statement quoted George Koob, a researcher with the Scripps Research Institute in San Diego, as saying.
"Cannabinoid (marijuana) use...may lead to a subtle disruption of brain processes that are then 'primed' for further and easier disruption by other drugs of abuse," he said.
The study was assisted by Spain's Interministerial Commission of Science and Technology.
